title: Preparation of TRIS Buffer Solution
author: Katy M Monteith
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.p2vdqe6

steps.title: Dissolve TRIS base
steps.instruction: Add 121.14g of TRIS base to 800 mL of triple distilled H₂O and stir on a magnetic plate using a magnetic flea until the TRIS base is completely dissolved.

steps.title: Adjust pH
steps.instruction: Adjust the pH of the solution to pH 8.0 using a pH meter by adding concentrated hydrochloric acid (HCl).

steps.title: Finalize solution volume
steps.instruction: Add triple distilled H₂O to bring the final volume of the solution to 1 L.
